quests.instruction: A colleague is arriving late. Describe the room and where they should look for their place.
quests.hint: Start with the table, then the equipment, then where the refreshments are.
quests.explanation: This is a workplace task: the learner organizes information so a late colleague knows where to go, using clear order and connectors.
quests.sceneText: Conference Room|name cards at each seat|laptop plugged into a cable|coffee station by the window
quests.sampleAnswer: The conference table has name cards at each seat, so you'll find your place by your name. A laptop is already plugged into the display cable at the head of the table, and the coffee station is by the window.
acceptedSynonyms: name cards,place cards,cards at each seat
coffee station,coffee table,coffee by the window

quests.instruction: A new employee asks how to use the shared desk area. Describe what they should do first.

quests.instruction: Explain how the planning board is organized, as if you are walking a colleague through it.

quests.instruction: You are calling customer service to report a damaged package. Describe the damage clearly. Start with the biggest damage on the box.

quests.sceneText: Damaged Parcel|torn tape on the lid|box with a large dent|cracked mug inside
quests.sampleAnswer: I'd like to report a damaged parcel. The box has a large dent on one side, the tape on the lid is torn, and when I looked inside, the mug was cracked.

dented box,box with a dent,large dent

quests.instruction: Explain to a store assistant what is wrong with the order. Start with what you actually received.
quests.hint: Say what you received, what you ordered, and what you have kept.

quests.sampleAnswer: I received a green jacket, but the packing slip says I ordered a blue one. I've kept the return label in case I need to send it back.
options: Packing slip showing a blue jacket
acceptedSynonyms: green jacket,jacket in the bag,wrong jacket
packing slip,slip showing a blue jacket,order slip

quests.instruction: Describe your item and what you've brought to the service desk.

toaster,cracked toaster,toaster with a cracked casing

quests.instruction: A new guest asks where things are. Explain the layout in order, starting with the kitchen.

quests.sampleAnswer: The kitchen is the first room on the right, with long tables and a big fridge. The bunk room door is at the end of the corridor, and the notice board with tour flyers is just before it.

notice board,board with flyers,tour flyer board

quests.instruction: Explain to a visitor how to read the map: where they are and where the museum is. Start with where they are.

quests.sampleAnswer: The red 'You are here' marker is near the bottom left. The museum icon is up and to the right, about two blocks away, and the train station icon is on the far left.

quests.instruction: Explain to a traveler what to do when returning a rental car. Focus on where to leave the keys.
quests.hint: Give the steps in order, using the signs and landmarks.

acceptedSynonyms: return lane sign,sign for returns,return sign

acceptedSynonyms: drying rack,rack for finished work,rack by the window

quests.instruction: Explain to a student how to book a study room.

quests.instruction: Explain to someone where to go to submit an application. End with where to submit it.
quests.hint: Give the steps in order: where to get the form, where to queue, which window.

quests.sampleAnswer: First, pick up a form from the table with pens, then follow the rope-lined queue. Window number three is the one where you submit it.

quests.instruction: Explain how to use this machine, starting from the screen.
quests.hint: Go in the order a user would: screen, card, receipt.
quests.explanation: The learner explains a machine process by following the user's steps and using 'then' and 'after that'.
quests.sceneText: Pass Machine|touchscreen with a menu|card slot below the screen|receipt slot at the bottom

acceptedSynonyms: card slot,slot below the screen,card reader

quests.instruction: Describe this slide to a colleague who cannot see it: title, chart, and key detail. Make the main graphic your focus.
quests.hint: Say what is at the top, then what is below it, then the key detail.

quests.sceneText: Slide on a Screen|title at the top|legend at the right|bar chart with four bars
quests.sampleAnswer: The title at the top says 'Sales by Quarter'. Below it there's a bar chart with four bars, and the third bar is the tallest. A legend on the right shows the colors.

quests.instruction: Describe what is on the table to someone looking for the agenda; mention what is where.
quests.hint: Name the agenda first, then the two other items by position.

quests.sceneText: Meeting Table|closed laptop|agenda printout with checkmarks|open notebook with notes
quests.sampleAnswer: The agenda printout is in the middle, and it has checkmarks next to the first two items. An open notebook with handwritten notes is on the right, and a closed laptop is on the left.

quests.instruction: Describe the community clean-up setup to a neighbor who couldn't come, in six to eight sentences: what it looks like, who is doing what, and how things are organized. Start with the large map.
quests.hint: Start with the place, then the map, then the volunteers, then supplies, then what happens outside.
quests.explanation: Level 170 asks for a community scene described in six to eight sentences with natural transitions and an efficient order.
quests.sceneText: Clean-Up Meeting|map with marked areas|volunteers at a table|bags and gloves
quests.sampleAnswer: The clean-up starts at a community center with a long table at the entrance. A large map on the wall has areas marked in different colors, and volunteers are crowding around it to choose their area. Behind them, another group is signing in at the table. Boxes of bags and gloves are stacked on the floor near the door, and some volunteers are already putting them on. In the corner, a few children are drawing signs. Outside, a truck is parked and waiting to collect the filled bags.
acceptedSynonyms: volunteers at a table,people signing in,volunteers

quests.instruction: Describe the food bank in six to eight sentences: layout, who is doing what, and how it all connects. Make the people packing the focus.
quests.hint: Start with the shelves, then the people packing, then the door, then the line outside.
quests.explanation: The learner describes a community service as a flow (shelves, packing, door, line), which makes it easy to follow.
quests.sceneText: Food Bank|shelves stocked with cans|volunteers packing boxes|line of people outside
quests.sampleAnswer: Inside the food bank, tall shelves are stocked with cans and boxes along both walls. In the middle, a group of volunteers is packing boxes at a long table, and each person has a different job: one puts in rice, another adds tins. Near the door, a woman is checking a list as boxes are carried out. Outside, a line of people is waiting along the pavement in an orderly way. A handwritten sign on the door lists the opening hours. The whole space looks organized, with each step in a clear order.
acceptedSynonyms: shelves with cans,stocked shelves,cans on shelves

quests.instruction: Describe this community meeting in six to eight sentences and end with how people can speak.
quests.hint: Start with the hall, then the audience, then the speaker, then the notes and phones, then the microphone.
quests.explanation: The final task asks for a meeting scene described in a clear order with transitions, ending on the detail about how people can speak.
quests.sceneText: Town Meeting|people seated in rows|speaker at a podium|microphone stand in the aisle
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a town meeting in a large hall. Most seats are taken, with people sitting in rows facing the front. A speaker stands at a podium, and behind him a screen shows the agenda. A few people are taking notes, while others are looking at their phones. Along the side aisle, two people are lining up at a microphone stand to ask questions. A table at the back has coffee and leaflets.
acceptedSynonyms: speaker,speaker at a podium,man at the podium
microphone stand,microphone in the aisle,mic stand
